# TravelItineraryIsolated

## Summary

The planner's full app surface: destination + date-range header, a drag-and-drop stop list grouped by day (collapsible day sections, per-day drop targets), the map panel rendered through the shared MapRender component, an AI trip-planning popover, and a share-QR panel. The Itinerary header shows the stop count and, when any stop carries an `estimatedCost`, the computed `~$N est.` trip total. Stops are edited in place via the ItineraryStop field's own edit component — no edit-mode switch needed.

## Usage

Wired as the card's isolated format:

```ts
static isolated = TravelItineraryIsolated;
```
